findings_aggregated_for_sde.desc: [AI-SAST via Code Scan Verification Validation | claude-opus-5] No homemade or re-implemented cryptographic primitive appears on either reviewed path. app/apis/auth/utils/utils.py delegates all password hashing and verification to passlib's CryptContext (argon2id first for new hashes, bcrypt retained for verification only) with cost parameters pinned in code so a library upgrade cannot silently weaken them. app/jwt_tokens.py performs all signing and verification through python-jose jwt.encode/jwt.decode and draws jti from secrets.token_urlsafe; the algorithm is a module literal and is never read from the token header. Alternative mitigation accepted: exclusive use of maintained, widely deployed third-party cryptographic libraries with explicitly pinned parameters satisfies the CM's requirement to use only tested implementations | verdict=pass confidence=high
